owns: semver parsing, validation, formatting, and increment selection
chain.json and metadata.json parsing and normalized version-path resolution
snapshot creation, metadata history, atomic current-chain mutation, and changelog copying
version listing, rollback backup/restore, and typed agent comparison
invariants: all version-control contract parsing and mutation is typed
invalid JSON and malformed version-history records fail closed rather than selecting a shell fallback
current-chain and metadata-history JSON publication uses a temporary file and atomic rename; snapshot and rollback backup copies remain explicit copy operations
the external diff command is the only child-process behavior retained by the typed contract
